meetings.title: City Council Committee on Public Safety and Criminal Justice Hearing on Docket #0180
meetings.summary:
City Council Committee on Public Safety and Criminal Justice Hearing on Docket #0180
 A hearing to discuss resources for the Boston Police Crime Lab.
 The public can offer testimony.
 Discussion Topics
 Docket #0180
 Order for a hearing to discuss resources to the Boston Police Crime Lab. 
 This matter was referred to the Committee on January 28, 2026. 
 NOTICE: The Boston City Council may have a quorum in attendance due to standing committees of the City Council consisting of both voting and non-voting members. However, members attending this duly posted meeting are participating and deliberating only in conjunction with the business of the standing committee. 
 Public Testimony 
 Members of the public are cordially invited to attend and testify in person or virtually. Those wishing to testify in person should arrive five (5) minutes before the call of the hearing to sign up. Please bring fifteen (15) copies of any written documentation you wish to present at the hearing. Those wishing to testify virtually via videoconference should email the staff contact for a link and instructions to do so. Written comments may be sent to the Committee or staff email (below) and will be made a part of the record and available to all Councilors. The public may watch this hearing via live stream at boston.gov/city-council-tv and on Xfinity 8/RCN 82/Fios 964. This hearing will be recorded. 
 Staff Contact: Ron Cobb 
 Mail Address: Docket #0180 City Council, City Hall, 5th Floor, Boston, MA 0

 A hearing to discuss fulfillment of community benefits funded by development projects.
 The public can offer testimony.
 Discussion Topics
 Docket #1337
 Order for a hearing to discuss fulfillment of community benefits funded by development projects. 
 This matter was sponsored by Councilor Enrique J. Pepén, Benjamin J. Weber, and Ruthzee Louijeune, and was referred to the Committee on July 8, 2026. 
 NOTICE: The Boston City Council may have a quorum in attendance due to standing committees of the City Council consisting of both voting and non-voting members. However, members attending this duly posted meeting are participating and deliberating only in conjunction with the business of the standing committee. 
 Public Testimony 
 Members of the public are cordially invited to attend and testify in person or virtually. Those wishing to testify in person should arrive five (5) minutes before the call of the hearing to sign up. Please bring fifteen (15) copies of any written documentation you wish to present at the hearing. Those wishing to testify virtually via videoconference should email the staff contact for a link and instructions to do so. Written comments may be sent to the Committee or staff email (below) and will be made a part of the record and available to all Councilors. The public may watch this hearing via live stream at boston.gov/city-council-tv and on Xfinity 8/RCN 82/Fi
